Chez-moi

Chez-moi is a secure property rental platform where landlords list homes and clients can view and rent properties. The platform emphasizes verification, secure booking workflows, and protections for both renters and hosts.

Project Overview

Chez-moi allows landlords to present properties with detailed listings and images, manage availability, and accept bookings. Renters can schedule visits, review property details, and complete secure transactions through the platform.
